# Model definition and priors

The full definition of the model at the release analysed, every prior with its source, the prior predictive check and the in-sample checks are in the report site archived with that release, {{< meta release_tag >}} [@bvdoutbreaksize-zenodo].
Its Methods page is the model as fitted, and its Estimates, Forecasts and Evaluation pages carry every result the main text summarises.

# Gradient and build benchmarks

![**Joint-model gradient time from the benchmark records.**
Open markers are the time before and filled markers the time after the same pull request, for the production joint model and the continuous-integration benchmark model on a log axis.
One pull request recorded only the time before its change.
The single recorded wall-clock of a headline fit is drawn as a diamond whose height carries no value.
Thin vertical lines are release tags and the background bands the three model versions.](figures/fig-gradient-si.pdf){#fig-gradient-si width=90%}

The hand-written reverse-mode rules for the daily convolution, renewal and observation kernels cut the joint gradient time by about {{< meta gradient_speedup_joint_percent >}}% in the recorded benchmarks, and the treatment-flow, occupancy and onset-reporting kernels ran {{< meta gradient_speedup_kernels_min >}} to {{< meta gradient_speedup_kernels_max >}} times faster when timed on their own (@fig-gradient-si). <!-- PRs 810, 837, 856 -->
A precompile workload that compiles the fit the report runs cut the cold build of the joint fit by a factor of {{< meta precompile_cold_build_factor >}} in the same records. <!-- PR 791 -->
